transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, my carbon monoxide detector is going off and I've had a mild headache all morning. Can someone please come check it?

Carbon monoxide is dangerous, so please get everyone out into fresh air right now, and leave the door open behind you. Once you're outside, call nine-one-one, especially if anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea. Don't go back in until the fire department says it's safe.
Okay, I'm going outside now and I'll call 911. Thank you. Goodbye.
Please stay outside and call nine-one-one immediately.
Thank you for doing that. Stay outside and wait for emergency responders.
Goodbye, and please stay safe outside while you wait for help.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, avoided jargon, asked one thing at a time, and did not repeat or invent information.
